lines.en: What would you like to say?
: {i}Second, why'd you get a tattoo of a butterfly?{/i}
: {i}I just wanted a tattoo when I was younger and saw a cute butterfly design in the artist's book{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我年轻的时候就是想纹个身，然后在纹身师的作品集里看到一个可爱的蝴蝶图案{/i}

lines.en: : {i}So I was like one butterfly please and then that happened{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}于是我就说「来一只蝴蝶谢谢」，然后就变成这样了{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I wanna get one with Sana but she's afraid of needles lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想和 Sana 一起纹一个，可她怕针 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'll try to talk her into it.{/i}
: {i}You're not going to make any money giving drinks away.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你这样白送酒是赚不到钱的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I'm telling you I want you to come over lol{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我都说了我想让你过来 lol{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Why lure me with drinks when you can just take the rest of your clothes off?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你直接把剩下的衣服脱了不就行了，何必拿酒来引诱我？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The rest can come off when you get here :){/i}
: {i}Is there any Sunny D at your place?{/i}
: {i}We only have stuff from the local brewery{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们只有本地酿酒厂的东西{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It's an orange concentrate drink from America.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是一种美国的橙味浓缩饮料。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And it's what I want right now.{/i}
: {i}Is that really where your mind went after getting my picture?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}收到我的照片之后，你脑子里想的就是这个？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I obviously don't have any Sunny D{/i}
: {i}Then I will not be coming over tonight.{/i}
